🔐 CipherDecode

An encoded message appears — letters have been systematically replaced (a simple substitution cipher). Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. The cipher text uses a consistent letter substitution.
  2. Look for common letters (E, T, A, O) and common words (THE, AND).
  3. Replace letters one by one to gradually reveal the message.
  4. Some puzzles give you a hint letter to get started.
  5. Frequency analysis: count how often each symbol appears to guess common letters.
